sources.title: Harbor Arts access guide
sources.body: Synthetic fixture. The venue guide states that the quiet room is step-free. Studio access is step-free. This is not a real venue observation.

sources.title: Visitor report: quiet-room threshold
sources.body: Synthetic fixture. A visitor reports a raised threshold at door-corridor-quiet. The venue has disputed the report; no follow-up measurement exists.

sources.body: Synthetic fixture. A 0.8 by 0.8 metre trolley stands at (8.0, 2.7) metres in the gallery, intersecting the stored entrance route. Moving it to (13.5, 5.3) is a proposed alternative, not a published change.
